title: A case study of one hospital IT rollout
abstract: This paper reports a bounded case in one hospital. Interviews and site notes support an account of that setting.
label: Case Study

title: A conceptual account of software trust
abstract: We argue for a conceptual framework. The contribution is the argument, not a new sample or system.
label: Conceptual

title: We present a toolkit for static analysis
abstract: We present a toolkit and describe the architecture. An evaluation checks that the prototype runs.
label: Design/Engineering

title: Comparing methods for programming error detection
abstract: We evaluate three approaches on a held-out benchmark and compare precision, recall and running time.
label: Experimental

title: A survey of prior work on code review tools
abstract: This article reviews existing studies. Search, selection and synthesis of the literature are the method.
label: Review

title: Ethnography of a single open-source project
abstract: An in-depth study of one project. The case is the unit of analysis.
label: Case Study

title: Towards a taxonomy of review comments
abstract: We introduce a conceptual taxonomy through reasoning and worked examples, without new observations.
label: Conceptual

title: An open-source compiler pipeline
abstract: We design and implement a compiler pipeline. Source code is available. Results validate the artefact.
label: Design/Engineering

title: A user study of error messages
abstract: Participants completed tasks. We compare conditions and report statistically summarised outcomes.
label: Experimental

title: Systematic literature review of testing oracles
abstract: A systematic literature review. Studies were selected and synthesised; no new primary experiment is reported.
label: Review
